policy: Mapped allotment polygons and delivered ground only. Three planted strips and two discontinuous low hedge accents are illustrative cultivation cues, not measured beds, parcel boundaries or a cadastral allotment layout. No huts, fences, trees or paths are invented. Existing geometry is untouched. At most 48 groups per existing packet, independently checked in drawn and orthogonal native form. All live delivery and residency budgets are unchanged.
